fusions.name: Ramming Nudge
fusions.desc: A head-down ram that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stamping Ground
fusions.desc: Stamps in place, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Won't Budge
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-In Heels
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
